Space expansion and utilization

Flexible and changeable space: The unique of the expandable container house can be flexibly expanded or retracted according to actual needs, easily realizing the expansion and contraction of space. When expanded, the indoor space is greatly increased, which can meet a variety of functional needs; after contraction, the volume becomes smaller, which is convenient for transportation and storage.


High space utilization rate: The layout of the expandable container house is more reasonable, and every inch of space is effectively utilized. The bedroom, living room, kitchen, bathroom and other functional areas can be freely planned according to customer needs, which improves the overall utilization rate of the space and avoids space waste

Materials and Structure

Materials and Structure

Sturdy and durable: The main frame is made of high-strength high-quality steel, which is precisely processed and welded, and has a stable structure. It can withstand various severe weather and external impacts, such as strong winds and earthquakes, and provide you with a safe and stable living or use environment.


Excellent quality: The walls, roofs, floors and other parts adopt multi-layer composite structures and high-quality materials, with good thermal insulation, waterproof and moisture-proof, fire retardant, sound insulation and noise reduction, etc., effectively maintaining a comfortable indoor temperature, reducing external noise interference, and creating a comfortable and safe indoor environment for you.

Personalized design

Meet diverse needs: Our collapsible container house can be customized according to different needs of customers. Whether it is used for characteristic homestays in tourist attractions, temporary residences for field operations, or as mobile office spaces, creative studios, etc., we can tailor an exclusive space layout that meets the usage scenarios and functional requirements for you.


Free style matching: In terms of appearance and interior style, you can freely choose, from simple modern to European classical, from pastoral style to industrial style, our design team can perfectly present your favorite style, making your expandable container house unique and showing personality and taste.

Rich configuration options

Customized facilities and equipment: We provide a wide range of facilities and equipment for you to choose from, from basic water and electricity systems, doors and windows, furniture, to high-end intelligent control systems, environmental protection and energy-saving equipment, etc. You can choose according to your budget and needs to ensure that your house is fully equipped, comfortable and convenient.


Optional material quality: We also give customers full autonomy in the selection of building materials. You can choose different materials for walls, roofs, floors and other materials according to your requirements for house performance and quality, such as new composite materials with better thermal insulation performance, more textured solid wood floors, etc., to meet your personalized pursuit of house quality.

Fast delivery and cost control

Efficient customization process: We have a professional design and production team, as well as a complete supply chain system. We can quickly complete the design, production and delivery of expandable container house while ensuring the quality of customization, so that you can own your favorite house as soon as possible and save your time and cost.


Cost optimization: Through long-term cooperation with suppliers and optimized production processes, we can effectively control costs for you during the customization process, provide cost-effective customization solutions, and ensure that you get the best quality customization services at a reasonable price to maximize value.

FAQ

1
Can the Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing be used in both Australia and New Zealand?
Yes, the Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing is suitable for use in both Australia and New Zealand.
2
What are the dimensions of the expandable housing when fully expanded?
When fully expanded, the dimensions of the Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing are approximately 40 feet in length.
3
Is the Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing a luxury accommodation option?
Yes, the Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing is designed to provide a luxury accommodation experience.
4
How does the luxury folding container home work?
The luxury folding container home utilizes an expandable design which allows it to be compact during transportation and expand into a larger living space at its destination.
5
Are there any specific applications for the Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing?
The Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing can be used for various applications including temporary housing, vacation homes, and additional living spaces.
6
Can the expandable housing be easily transported to different locations?
Yes, the Factory Supply Living 40 Feet Expandable Housing is designed for easy transportation and can be easily relocated to different locations as needed.
